description: Known gaps for desktop/tools/check_slice_symbol_closure.py. A gap listed here is accepted; a gap listed but no longer observed is stale and fails the gate (a partial run judges only the gaps its checks can observe). Every slice appends the gaps it knowingly leaves and removes the ones it closes. closedByEvidence says how firm the owner is: roadmap = that slice's roadmap text names the symbol; proposed = the gap author's inference, to be confirmed or reassigned by the slice owner; unassigned = no roadmap slice owns it. retiredSeeds are roadmap seeds a generated shim already defines; the gate fails if one loses its definer.

Verbatim upstream file in a carried slice archive references a symbol that no compiled, carried or vendored source declares. The producers adapt or never emit the referencing declaration today; whichever slice emits it whole must first bring the definer. No roadmap slice names this symbol yet; the owner of the first slice that emits the referencing file must assign it.

gaps.reason: Verbatim upstream file in a carried slice archive references prefersTextureVideoSurface, which no compiled, carried or vendored source declares. The roadmap names it only as an exclusion (v032-android-service-surface-build is superseded-by-desktop: the Windows media service replaces prefersTextureVideoSurface with false), so no slice brings it and the first slice that emits the referencing file must apply that replacement.

retiredSeeds.reason: Roadmap seed AppBottomSheetMotion.reducedMotion (Source260 compile errors in CommentContentReveal and CommentCascadingContent, 2 errors): upstream v0.4.6 declares the member and the pinned carried AppSheetComponents lacks it. RETIRED, not open: v046_comment_list.py emits the compat extension COMPAT_REDUCED_MOTION (internal val AppBottomSheetMotion.reducedMotion, constant false) as DesktopOriginalCommentMotionCompat.kt, so the reads have a definer today. The slice fnd-sheet-motion-and-glyph replaces that shim with the real member, which also satisfies this check. The gate fails if the symbol loses every definer.
